Shapes.author: Evolus Pencil Team
Shapes.description: Enterprise UI stencils conforming to Ant Design v5, featuring design tokens, primary color cascade, scalable typography, and rich data presentation components.
Shapes.instructions: Ant Design 2026 (antd 5.29.3). The collection uses antd's default light theme only. The collection settings primaryColor, borderRadius and defaultFont are read when a shape is placed: every default and every named style is evaluated against them, and placed shapes never restyle afterwards. defaultFont (embedded Roboto, 14px) is the UI scale. Every size in these instructions is for 14px and scales by fontSize / 14, except 1px borders and 2px focus rings. A text line is round(fontSize x 1.5714) high (22 at 14px). Agents cannot measure text: at 14px estimate a label (one or two words) as 8px per character + 8, and running text as 7px per character; count M and W twice and scale with the font size (12px text: x 12 / 14). Every antd type, size, state and colour (button types and sizes, input sizes and Error / Disabled, alert and message types, table sizes, tag colours, ...) is a named style of its base shape, listed in the shape's usage guidelines as @evolus.pencil.ant2026/<shortcut_id>. Put that name in the element's style field instead of writing colours; a style also sets the box and the structure of that variant. To combine a state or colour style with a size style, give the style field an array, the size last (for example [table_cell_selected, table_cell_small]): later styles win where they overlap. Set properties directly only for content (labels, values, icons, counts) or for a deliberately off-spec look. Every colour is a plain property: fillColor, strokeColor, textColor and named slots such as iconColor, descriptionColor or disabledFillColor. No Enum selects a colour. Structural Enums and Bools (mode, state, status, type, placement, position, groupPosition, sorter, ...) change geometry, glyphs and visibility, never colours: after changing one, apply the matching style. The exceptions draw with colour slots the shape already holds, so set them directly: disabled (the disabled* slots), checked / indeterminate on radio, checkbox and switch (the checked* slots) and status on input (errorColor / warningColor). Sizes (sm / default / lg) are named styles that write the height, padding, radius, icon size and font together: use them rather than editing those numbers one by one. The box is the outer edge, border included. Shadows, focus rings, the popover arrow, the open select dropdown and the textarea count are drawn outside it. Shapes do not resize when their content changes. Designers have Fit actions that agents cannot run, so each shape's own instructions give the size to write after changing its content. Icons are ImageData written 24,24,collection://vectors/<name>.svg with these Ant glyphs: arrow-up bar-chart bell calendar caret-down caret-up check check-circle check-circle-fill clock-circle close close-circle close-circle-fill copy dashboard delete dollar down download edit environment exclamation-circle exclamation-circle-fill export eye eye-invisible file file-text filter filter-fill folder global inbox info-circle info-circle-fill left loading mail minus more paper-clip phone picture plus question-circle reload right search setting star star-fill swap-right team truck up user. Repeating UI is built from atoms placed edge to edge, never from list properties: menus (menu_item), tables (table_header_cell, table_cell), descriptions (descriptions_cell), steps, breadcrumbs, tabs (tab_item on tabs_bar), timelines and trees. Use overlay as the page, card or dropdown surface and as the modal mask. Buttons in card bodies, toolbars and custom footers are separate button shapes; modal_shell, drawer_shell and popover_panel draw their own OK / Cancel footers.

Shape.instructions: A single glyph: icon is ImageData (see the collection's glyph list), iconColor its colour. The box is the glyph size: 16 by default, 14 inside 14px text.
text is RichText and wraps inside the box. Height = lines x the line height: 22 for body text; one line of a title style is H1 46, H2 38, H3 32, H4 28, H5 24 (font 38 / 30 / 24 / 20 / 16).

Shape.instructions: A plain rounded surface. Styles: overlay_surface (page or layout background), overlay_card (white card or dropdown panel with shadow), overlay_backdrop (the 45% black modal mask: size it to the page and place it under modal_shell or drawer_shell).

Height 32 (button_sm 24, button_lg 40 with 16px text). Width = 2 x 16 + the label width (2 x 8 for button_sm), plus 14 + 8 for each icon (16 + 8 at large). button_icon is square (box.h x box.h) with only leadingIcon. leadingIcon and trailingIcon are ImageData; an empty value means no icon. Joined groups: set groupPosition row_first / row_middle / row_last and place the members edge to edge. Members after the first have no left border, so make them 1px narrower than they would be alone. Column groups use column_first / column_middle / column_last, stacked top to bottom, 1px shorter after the first.

count stars of starSize with gap between them; value is the number of filled stars (halves allowed). Box width = count x starSize + (count - 1) x gap (132 x 20 for 5 stars).

Shape.instructions: One menu row. Inline (sidebar) and vertical (dropdown) rows: 40 high; place them 4px inside the menu's left and right edges (width = menu width - 8), 4px apart, starting 4px from the menu's top. A level 2 row (level=2) indents by indentSize (24). Horizontal (top bar) rows: 46 high, width = 2 x 16 + (icon ? 14 + 10 : 0) + the label width, placed edge to edge on the header. Use the menu_item_* styles for selected, active, submenu and disabled rows; state alone only draws the horizontal ink bar. A sidebar menu sits on a layout_sider or a white overlay; a dropdown menu sits on an overlay_card with 4px padding.

Shape.instructions: The 1px bottom rule of a tab strip: line tabs 46 high, card tabs (tabs_bar_card) 40. Place tab_item atoms on it from its left edge; the bar's width is the content width.

Line tabs: 46 high, width = the label width + 2 x 16 (+ 14 + 8 with an icon); placed edge to edge on tabs_bar, the first one 16px left of where its label should start. A line tab centres its icon and label in the box and draws the ink bar under them only. Tab labels never wrap or clip, so estimate them tighter than other labels: 7px per character (M and W count twice); the 16px padding absorbs a short estimate. Card tabs: 40 high, width = the label width + 34 (+ 28 when closable), 2px apart. Use tab_item_*_active for the selected tab: state alone draws only the ink bar or the open card edge.

Shape.instructions: One shape for the whole pager, 32 high (pagination_sm 24). Its width depends on totalPages, showTotal and showSizeChanger: start from the box of the matching pagination style, which shows 5 pages. As in antd, up to 7 pages are all shown; more pages show 7 items at either end of the range (1 2 3 4 5 ••• 129) and 9 in its middle (1 ••• 6 7 8 9 10 ••• 129). Add 40 for each item beyond 5, and 6 more for a 3-digit last page (14 for 4 digits). currentPage selects the highlighted page. The pager is drawn from the box's left edge: place it by its right edge (for a table, the card's right padding).

Shape.instructions: Body cells, 55 high (table_cell_middle 47, _small 39), same widths and position as the header cells above; rows stack edge to edge under the header. Text is 16px inside (8 when middle or small); align right for numbers (table_cell_numeric), ellipsis for one-line truncation. Content other than text (tags, links, avatars) is placed on the cell at its padding: 16px from its left and top (middle: 8 from the left, 12 from the top; small: 8 and 8).

Shape.instructions: Count badge: height 20 (badge_small 14); width = 20 for one digit, else the count width + 16. Put it on the top-right corner of its target: badge centre on the target's top-right corner. badge_dot: a 6 x 6 dot on the corner. badge_status: a 6px dot + 8 + the status text width, 22 high, inline with text. badge_status is antd status success (fillColor #52C41A); for the other statuses set fillColor: processing #1677FF, warning #FAAD14, error #FF4D4F, default #00000040.

Shape.instructions: Height 22 (line height 20 + border); width = the label width + 2 x 7 + 2, + 13 when closable. Tag labels are 12px: estimate them as 7px per character (M and W count twice), so width = 7 x characters + 16. Place tags 8px apart. Colours and statuses are the tag_* styles.

Shape.instructions: Width 520 (modal_confirm and modal_info 416), centred over an overlay_backdrop mask that covers the page; the top about 100px below the page top. Height = 52 + content lines x 22 + 20 + (showFooter ? 44 : 0): 138 for one line with the footer. The content wraps at box.w - 48 - (showIcon ? 34 : 0). The footer draws OK (okText, primary) and Cancel (cancelText, showCancel) at the bottom right; for other buttons set showFooter=false, add 44 to the height and place button shapes 24px from the right and 20px from the bottom. Kinds: modal_confirm / modal_info styles (icon + title). A danger OK (delete confirmations): okFillColor #FF4D4F, okShadowColor #FF26050F.

Shape.instructions:
placement names where the panel sits relative to its target (top = above it); the 8px arrow is drawn outside the box on the side facing the target. Place the box 8px from the target so the arrow tip touches it, centred on it (or aligned to its start / end for topLeft, bottomRight, leftTop, ...). Size: width = 12 + max(the title width (600 weight), the widest content line, 177 when a title shows) + 12; height = 12 + (showTitle ? 22 + 8 : 0) + content lines x 22 + 12. content lines are separated by
. Popconfirm (confirm=true, popconfirm style): width = 12 + 14 + 8 + max(title, description) + 12, at least 24 + the buttons (OK and Cancel each the text width + 16, 8px apart); height = 12 + 22 + 4 + lines x 22 + 8 + 24 + 12 (104 for one line). A danger OK: okFillColor #FF4D4F, okShadowColor #FF26050F.

Shape.instructions: Line: height 22 (progress_small 19 with 12px text); the width is free and includes the info (the percent text or the status icon) 8px after the bar. Stack lines 8 to 16px apart. Circle (progress_circle*): 120 x 120 (small 80 x 80). percent is 0 to 100. Status styles: progress_success, progress_exception (the circle ones show a check or a cross in the centre).

Dots only: 20 x 20 (spin_small 14, spin_large 32). With a tip (spin_tip, showTip): width = max(dotSize, the tip width), height = dotSize + (dotSize - 14) / 2 + 2 + 22 (47 by default). Centre it over the loading area.

Property.name: tip
Property.p:editInfo: ({targetName: 'spinChrome', bound: new Bound(0, Math.min($box.h, $dotSize.value), $box.w, Math.max(0, $box.h - $dotSize.value)), font: $textFont, align: new Alignment(1, 2)})
